fullPassage:
A good example of chaos is the magnetic pendulum sold as an executive toy. It has four magnets arranged in a square at the base and a pendulum that swings back and forth between them.

(A) In order to produce chaos, the iteration has to be within what is called a nonlinear system. Nor are all nonlinear systems chaotic: to become so they need to be pushed beyond a certain point, called a bifurcation. Before that point is reached they may behave in a quite orderly fashion.

(B) Release the pendulum and note the magnets that it visits, and in what order. If the pendulum is released from the same position a second time, the pattern of movement may at first be the same but soon it will become completely different. In fact, the pattern of its movement is chaotic.

(C) No matter how much care is taken to start the pendulum in the same position, it will visit an entirely different set of points on the two occasions. Chaotic systems are generated by iteration, though not all iteration leads to chaos.

In order to produce chaos, the iteration has to be within what is called a nonlinear system. Nor are ③all nonlinear systems chaotic: to become so they need to be pushed beyond a certain point, called a bifurcation. Before that point is reached they may behave in a quite orderly fashion.

Release the pendulum and note the magnets that it visits, and in what order. If the pendulum is released from the same position a second time, the pattern of movement may at first be the same but soon it will become completely ④different. In fact, the pattern of its movement is chaotic.

No matter how much care is taken to start the pendulum in the same position, it will visit an entirely different set of points on the two occasions. Chaotic systems are generated by iteration, though not all iteration leads to chaos.
questions.stem: ①~④ 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?

det.korean: ② swing → swings: 주어가 a pendulum(단수)이므로 3인칭 단수
det.analysis:
❌ ①
✅ ②
❌ ③
❌ ④
✅ ② swing → swings: 관계대명사 that의 선행사 a pendulum(단수) → 동사도 단수
❌ ① sold: 과거분사 (수동)
❌ ③ has to be: ~이어야 한다
❌ ④ leads: iteration(단수) → 3인칭 단수
det.tip: 관계대명사 that의 동사는 선행사의 수에 일치: a pendulum that swings

questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 혼돈 시스템의 특성(같은 조건에서도 다른 결과)과 발생 조건(비선형 + 분기점 초과)
det.analysis:
❌ ① 혼돈 시스템의 특성과 발생 조건
❌ ② 자기 진자의 제조 방법과 원리
✅ ③ 비선형 시스템의 실용적 응용
❌ ④ 반복과 질서의 동일한 관계
❌ ①: 혼돈 시스템의 특성(예측 불가)과 조건(비선형+분기점)
❌ ②: 제조 방법은 언급 없음
✅ ③: 실용적 응용은 언급 없음
❌ ④: 반복이 항상 혼돈이 아님 — '동일한 관계'는 부적절
det.tip: 글의 핵심: chaos(혼돈) + nonlinear system(비선형) + bifurcation(분기점)

questions.stem:
위 글의 요약문으로 가장 적절한 것은?

The magnetic pendulum demonstrates that chaotic systems, which arise from (A) in nonlinear systems beyond a bifurcation point, produce (B) outcomes even from identical starting conditions.

det.korean: 자기 진자는 분기점을 넘는 비선형 시스템의 반복에서 발생하는 혼돈이 동일 출발 조건에서도 예측 불가능한 결과를 만듦을 보여준다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) iteration — (B) unpredictable
❌ ② (A) stability — (B) predictable
❌ ③ (A) balance — (B) identical
✅ ④ (A) iteration — (B) consistent
❌ ②: iteration(반복) + unpredictable(예측 불가능한)
❌ ①: stability(안정성)는 혼돈의 원인이 아님
❌ ③: identical(동일한) 결과가 아님
✅ ④: consistent(일관된) 결과가 아님
det.tip: iteration → chaos → unpredictable outcomes
